DGZ FORMULA DISCREPANCIES vs design 8.2 (DGZ evaluate.py / evaluate_terms.py / utils.py, read with web_fetch; documented in go_function/evaluate.py header):
1. IC: DGZ computes IC from train+valid+TEST prop_annotations (calculate_ic(annotations + test_annotations)); design 8.2 says train+valid. DGZ-faithful mode follows DGZ (needed to hit Smin); study mode ic_from_labels follows the design (train+valid TP).
2. AUPR: DGZ's AUPR is np.trapz over the 101-threshold PROTEIN-centric (recall, precision) points sorted by recall, not a micro AUPR over flattened pairs. Study mode protein_centric() returns both aupr_micro (micro P/R per threshold, same trapezoid rule) and aupr_protein (DGZ definition); FEAT-004/005 must pick which one the report calls 'AUPR' (design says micro).
3. DGZ skips proteins with no true label in the evaluated set (evaluate_annotations 'continue'); both modes skip them in protein-centric metrics and report n_skipped_no_label (resolves FEAT-001's open question: TP eval sets keep empty-closure rows for class-centric metrics; protein-centric metrics drop them, as DGZ). Class-centric keeps every evaluation-set row.
4. DGZ's protein-centric label set = all namespace GO ids of the DgzRule dict (alt-id aliases included, root removed), not just terms.pkl columns, so recall counts unpredictable labels. Faithful mode keeps this; study mode uses the term set T only.
5. Threshold comparisons in float64 (DGZ's numpy-1 scalar semantics); class AUC on float32-cast preds (evaluate_terms.py stores a float32 matrix), roc_curve+auc per term with 0<n_pos<n. Fmax keeps DGZ's strict 'fmax < f' (first max); Smin uses IC, not normalised IC.
6. Paper: MF is Table 3, BP is Table 4 (plan said 'Table 3' for both); dgz_published.json cites the actual table/row/column per value.
